rows.reason: Removed from the standard on 12 November 2026: the complete multi-part export, dpp-evidence-export@1 (spec/portable-evidence.md section 2 as it stood, contracts/evidence-export.schema.json), is a reference feature of @bsv/dpp-overlay, GET /evidence-export, whose part schema moved to packages/dpp-overlay/schemas/evidence-export.schema.json. The standard's one export format is the dpp-evidence-package@1 per passport.

row.summary: A bounded package declares what it does not carry; a lineage longer than the bound is exported completely as dpp-evidence-export@1 parts over one snapshot, each a package over a contiguous sequence range bounded by states and bytes with at least one state, oldest first, resumed by cursor under the page rules, each carrying a coverage record (passport, snapshot, index, range, states, final, manifest digest) signed by the exporter and bound to the package manifest; a reader establishes coverage only from records that verify, tiles the snapshot from them, and refuses by name a repeated, missing, foreign, tampered, substituted, re-signed or falsely final part; a part is never complete for the snapshot unless it is the only part and carries no report.
row.applicability: when a service offers the complete export of a lineage longer than its bounded package
row.notes: The overlay serves GET /evidence-export (contracts/overlay.yaml 0.7.0-draft) with parts of at most 500 states and 16 MiB of transaction and proof bytes, an export-kind cursor under the history paginator's secret and TTL, and an optional EXPORT_TOKEN bearer forwarded by both Compose presets; inspectEvidenceExportPart and joinEvidenceExport are the reader's side. Tested with 505 connected states admitted through the wire: two parts, joined complete, restored into a second operator that serves the same history and exports again; parts closed on either bound; a state admitted mid-export kept out of the snapshot; tampered, foreign, crossed and expired cursors refused by name; a genuine first part with unsigned final, cursor and range edited to look whole refused by the coverage signature, as is every altered coverage fact, a substituted package and a record signed by another key. The registry does not yet serve a complete export; its bounded package is unchanged and this row binds it only when it offers one. Local synthetic evidence; no operator exercise; the signature attributes the coverage assertion and does not prove the exporter held everything that exists elsewhere.

row.summary: Under epcis-vsc@2 an event carrying an error declaration is unsupported as error-declaration, and the disposition is decided through the published crosswalk before a SEAL is built: active on an ObjectEvent that commissions its objects, in_transit and returned on no ObjectEvent that commissions or decommissions them, and dispensed and destroyed on no ObjectEvent that commissions them are carried verbatim; every other event is unsupported, its reason opening with custody-neutral (custody-destination-unnamed in its place at a receiving or accepting step), lifecycle-conflict, custody-transition-unnamed or non-cbv-disposition; an OBSERVE event without a disposition is custody-neutral; no VSC-only term is written for a CBV event and no custody rule is changed to give a custody-neutral event a SEAL.
